test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is: **protection.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"protection"** means the action of protecting someone or something, or the state of being protected. (सुरक्षा)

 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers were tasked with the protection of the village.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that the safeguarding of individual rights and liberties is another benefit of democracy. 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Delimitation** (सीमांकन): The action of fixing the boundary or limits of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The delimitation of the electoral boundaries was necessary for fair elections.
 
 
 
• **Diversion** (विचलन): The action of turning something aside from its course.
 
 
• **Example:** The construction caused a diversion of the main road.
 
 
 
• **Proscription** (प्रतिबंध): The action of forbidding something; banning.
 
 
• **Example:** The proscription of certain books was controversial.
